missing_evidence: Inventory error log detail confirming rejected config key/value and 503 cause
Confirmation that cfg-015 rejection is the direct cause of the checkout trace error
candidates.statement: Inventory deployment 3.3.5 introduced configuration revision cfg-015 that is invalid (configuration_valid=false, 3 min old). Inventory logs show 9 configuration_value_rejected errors with status 503, metrics show 14 configuration rejections, and the checkout trace to inventory errors at 1350ms. This bounded bad-configuration fault explains the degraded checkout health.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone cannot establish causation; error_rate 0.1 and p95 74ms suggest partial impact. No db pool waiters or dependency timeouts observed.

report.explanation: Inventory is the only service with errors: invalid configuration revision cfg-015 after deploy 3.3.5, 9 config_value_rejected 503 errors, 14 configuration rejections, and an errored checkout trace to inventory. Gateway, order, and payment logs are healthy. Bounded bad-configuration candidate supported; deployment record alone does not prove causation.
